label: Tennessee Wing
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3.25 in (wings 3.25 in, as patch-new-york-wing); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

ground_removed.flood: 4-neighbour flood from the picture's edge over pixels within 10 levels of the ground colour

band.rule: alpha from the pixel colour's place between the ground colour and the outline's solid colour, colour taken from the outline

provenance: Unit emblem of Tennessee Wing (SER-TN-001), digital artwork supplied by Ethan Hillard on 2026-11-12 as the wing's official digital emblem. Official digital artwork shipped as given: jpeg (1320 x 1281 px, on a plain light ground) -> png via sips; the ground that came around the emblem (opaque near-white (#f6f6f6, jpeg noise); 538734 px, found by a flood from the picture's edge) was made clear, and the 29694 px where the outline had been blended into it (up to 8 px deep) were given their alpha from where their colour lies between the ground colour and the outline's own solid colour (#f1c217) and took that colour, and the picture was trimmed to the emblem's box (1320 x 1281 px to 1320 x 1258 px; the result is 8-bit RGBA); the white inside the scroll, the ring round the blue disc and the triangle stay, being enclosed by the emblem's own outline; no resampling, no redrawing, no tracing, no other colour change. Charter: SER-TN-001 is Tennessee Wing HQ in the builder's unit list.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only changes are the ground around the emblem, made clear so the emblem sits on the garment, and the trim to the emblem's box.
